name: echarts-scatter-simple
title: Basic Scatter Chart
description: Basic Scatter Chart, adapted from the Apache ECharts examples.

files.content:
import { EChart, type EChartSetup } from "@/components/ui/echart"
import type { EChartsOption } from "echarts"

// Adapted from the Apache ECharts example "Basic Scatter Chart" (Apache-2.0):
// https://echarts.apache.org/examples/en/editor.html?c=scatter-simple
const setup: EChartSetup = () => {
  let option!: EChartsOption
  option = {
    xAxis: {},
    yAxis: {},
    series: [
      {
        symbolSize: 20,
        data: [
          [10.0, 8.04],
          [8.07, 6.95],
          [13.0, 7.58],
          [9.05, 8.81],
          [11.0, 8.33],
          [14.0, 7.66],
          [13.4, 6.81],
          [10.0, 6.33],
          [14.0, 8.96],
          [12.5, 6.82],
          [9.15, 7.2],
          [11.5, 7.2],
          [3.03, 4.23],
          [12.2, 7.83],
          [2.02, 4.47],
          [1.05, 3.33],
          [4.05, 4.96],
          [6.03, 7.24],
          [12.0, 6.26],
          [12.0, 8.84],
          [7.08, 5.82],
          [5.02, 5.68]
        ],
        type: 'scatter'
      }
    ]
  };
  return option
}

export function EchartsScatterSimple() {
  return <EChart setup={setup} />
}
